title: The Guided Prophets and Signs in Nature

paragraphs.text: Allah gave Abraham a strong argument. He gave him Isaac and Jacob. He guided Noah before them. He also guided David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses and Aaron. Zechariah, John, Jesus and Elias were righteous. Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah and Lot were chosen too. Follow their guidance. The Prophet asks no payment for this message.

Who sent down the Book that Moses brought? It was Allah. This Qur'an is a blessed Book. Who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah? At death, angels will take out the wrongdoers' souls. Each person comes to Allah alone.

Allah splits the seed and the date stone. He brings life out of death. He made the night for rest. He placed the stars to guide you. He sends rain and grows all plants. Look at the dates, grapes, olives and pomegranates. These are signs for believers.
